# Enable native drag events only for calendar items that opt into them

The all-day week item box now has draggable="true". The shared dragstart handler checks for a draggable ancestor before entering the native drag path, while timed day/week items use their mouse-based drag handlers. It also refuses unwritable calendars, disallowed changes and invitations, and selects the item before starting a permitted drag session. The attribute is part of this event-routing contract. The nearby property-change helper checks gripbars or the separate timed event box; it does not prove this all-day drag executes. This note is based on source inspection. Tests were not run, and full review discussion remains pending.

Scope: calendar/base/content.
